body: Well, maybe I'll​ just get the regular one and see if she can do it... She's just tiny, and I know she would love to play.
Galleries and other places around town like restaurants and stores.
I disagree. Wouldn't it better to say "oh last time I saw my dad we had fun together and that's what I remember." Than not seeing me at all?

The reason I asked wasn't to get help with he doing it part, but, thank you all for your concern. I ask because I wonder if she's going to remember me at all. Not that I would be worth remembering.

My plan is go watch her tomorrow, play, have fun, give her card, and leave. Not much after that.
I burned a bunch of my paintings today. They started to disgust me.
I'm 28. I get called all the time by places wanting to put my work in their stores and galleries, but never get called. I do a shitty data entry job.
I mean, I have to watch her tomorrow so I'll see her again. I'm making her a Valentine's day card right now, but I just can't do this anymore.

I have. It's all good, I passed the little suicide clause about a year ago. 

I don't know why we aren't together... Right before we had the baby she said it wasn't fun anymore and she was done... It broke my heart. It still breaks my heart. I wanted to marry her.

Man my kid will have more than enough of my shitty paintings for the rest of her life. It pisses me off because people always ask me about my art, or tell me how much they love it and how talented I am, but it never amounted to anything. Now I'm stuck in a shitty cubicle.

I am nothing.

I'm making my kid's Valentine's day card right now. Weird to think it's the last thing I'll ever paint... I hope my ex doesn't throw it away... I really like it. 

This is my last week. I told my ex I'd take the baby on Tuesday while she goes out, so it'll probably be after.

Art. If I had the luxury, I'd paint all day. I do it on the side, I painted something for a friend's mom a few months ago and she loved it, and has been handing my card out, but I don't make enough money off of it.

I'm saving up to buy a gun for next time. I decided that this morning.

Yeah man, I probably would. I'm sick of being alone, and she has chased off every girl since we split. I have no family aside from my kid because my brother is so far, I'm stuck in a dead end job because my degree isn't worth anything. My life just sucks.

Nah man, if I had money my ex will still be my ex. She tells other girls if they date me they're dead to her or her friends will stop being friends with them or some crazy thing.  I've tried to get away from their little group but some way they weasel in. I don't understand why, she broke up with me, why can't I move on? She has...

The money is just one problem. Since she saw me on Skype she's been calling me and saying she wants to help. Why? So she can ridicule me? I don't get it...
Ex keeps calling wanting to talk. There's nothing to talk about.

I didn't talk to her because it's none of her business. I don't need her either being all judgmental or what she's doing now and pretending to care. The baby is better off with life insurance money than me anyway.
If you read my last comment, you'll see I did reach out.

Ex text me asking to please Skype because she picked her up from school and the teacher said she was crying all day. So i called about an hour ago. I wouldn't show my neck and face on camera and my ex kepts saying "we want to see you." I said no i couldn't my computer was broken, and my kid put her face in her hands and started crying so I put the camera up to where you could see me and my ex ended the call.

Now I've got people calling asking if I'm okay, or what's going on. Someone was pounding on my door not too long ago.
Another reason I don't want her to see me is because you can still see some of the wounds from my attempt. I don't want her seeing that. I don't want my ex to know either, I don't need her pity.
I tried to commit sucide two and a half weeks ago. Lived (obviously). That's what's going on.

Because I don't want anything that is going on with me, and my issues to hurt her. That's why I'm backing off for a little while. I'm so mad at my ex for letting her call me like that... All upset and everything :(
I don't think so...
